## bench.time_spine
# Model: `time_spine`

Built-in virtual model (not stored; every datasource has one): every instant. Group by time_spine.timestamp at a granularity to get every bucket in range, empty ones included. Needs a lower bound (a date_range or a >= filter on the timestamp); the upper bound defaults to the current bucket. Each model is attributed through its axis — its default_time_dimension, else its only date/time column; it has no countable rows, and coalesce(<measure>, 0) fills empty buckets. source_model.name: roll90
source_model.sql: SELECT CAST(m.month_end AS VARCHAR) AS month_end, o.customer_id, o.status FROM (SELECT CAST(last_day(make_date(2025, g, 1)) AS DATE) AS month_end FROM range(1,13) t(g)) m JOIN orders o ON o.order_date > m.month_end - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND o.order_date <= m.month_end

args.message: In 2025, between 154 and 162 distinct customers placed an order in the 90 days ending on each month's last day. Each window covers 90 calendar days and includes the last day of the month, so it runs from that day minus 89 days through that day. All orders are counted, including those with status 'bad'. Customers are counted by their customer_id on the order.
